visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit studio setting where two individuals, a man and a woman, are seated in black professional gaming chairs with clear 'noblechairs' branding. The man, on the left, wears a black baseball cap, glasses, and a black T-shirt, while the woman on the right has long dark hair and a grey cardigan over a dark top. They sit behind a white desk equipped with microphones and monitors, looking intently at an inset video screen that displays various grainy, black-and-white security camera feeds of traditional Japanese household interiors. (2) As they watch the monitor, the scene cuts to a high-contrast close-up of a distorted, frightening face appearing suddenly in the security footage. The man reacts instantly with a physical jolt, throwing his head back and raising his hand in surprise, his facial expression shifting from concentration to shock. The woman also flinches slightly, her eyes widening as she looks at the man's intense reaction. Large, colorful traditional Chinese text overlays and variety-show style stickers appear around their heads to emphasize their emotional state. (3) The editing switches between the studio hosts and the game footage, showing a dark room under tattered tatami mats where a pale face is hidden. The man covers his eyes with his hands while the woman begins to laugh, pointing at the screen and then at him. The lighting in the studio remains consistent and bright, contrasting with the dark and eerie game footage. Text overlays continue to pop up at the bottom of the frame, providing comedic commentary on their fear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a male voice speaking at a moderate pace and conversational volume, explaining the mechanics of the game. A low-intensity, suspenseful ambient background track with synthetic drones and occasional dissonant notes creates a tense atmosphere. A female voice chimes in with brief, curious interjections. The recording is studio-quality with very high clarity and minimal background noise, focusing on the dialogue between the two hosts as they analyze the screen. (2) A sudden, loud percussive hit SFX (impact sound) triggers a sharp transition in the audio profile. Both the male and female speakers let out high-pitched, high-arousal screams that significantly increase the master volume levels. The male voice is particularly loud and strained, exhibiting high pitch variability and intensity. The BGM momentarily swells in volume to match the jump scare, followed by the sound of the female host's rapid laughter, which has a bright and energetic tone. (3) The tension subsides slightly as the hosts return to normal conversational volume, though their voices remain animated and slightly breathless from the shock. Comedic sound effects, such as a high-pitched 'ding' or a cartoonish slide whistle, are edited into the mix to accentuate the variety-show feel. The background music remains active, featuring a repetitive, eerie minor-key melody that maintains the horror theme while allowing the clear, enunciated speech of the hosts to remain the primary signal.
